Weapons & Evolutions

Raise a weapon to LV.8 and own its matching passive to evolve it from a Boss chest.

🥕 Carrot Dart＋ 🪵 Chew Stick🚀 Carrot Rocket

A high-speed explosive rocket that deals area damage on impact.

🌼 Dandelion Whirl＋ 🎀 Courage Bow🌸 Crown Blossom Storm

Two rings of colorful petals with greater reach and attack speed.

🌾 Hay Sickle＋ 👟 Nimble Paws⚔️ Golden Mower

Rapid 360-degree melee slashes.

🌻 Giant Sunflower Seed＋ 🎒 Hamster Backpack🌟 Seed Supernova

A massive blast triggers a core aftershock and splits into 8 piercing shards.

☀️ Sunbeam＋ 🍎 Apple Snack🌈 Rainbow Sun Cannon

Calls down three powerful rainbow beams at once.

🧪 Veggie Juice Bottle＋ 🏠 Cozy Nest🍇 Dreamy Veggie Garden

Throws two bottles, creating a larger, longer-lasting garden.

🌰 Boomerang Acorn＋ 🍀 Lucky Clover👑 Golden Acorn Barrage

Multiple acorns fly out and return, cutting through crowds twice.

🧀 Moon Cheese＋ 🔭 Stargazing Lens🌕 Full Moon Cheese Rain

Calls down three giant cheese meteors for massive area damage.

🫧 Bubble Wand＋ 🧣 Fluffy Scarf🌊 Deep-Sea Pearl Tide

Releases cyan pearl bubbles with much stronger piercing.

📕 Bedtime Storybook＋ 👑 Wisdom Crown📖 Endless Fairy Tale

Continuously calls down a wide rain of paper stars.

🔔 Nap Bell＋ 🛡️ Soft Shell Pad🔔 Dreamland Grand Bell

Rapidly releases huge violet-gold waves around the hero.
